Clinic appointment booking: daily challenge, 2027-01-15

The shared System Designer challenge for 2027-01-15: Clinic appointment booking. Build a design and test the same seeded traffic day as everyone else. Free, no sign-up.

Open the challenge

A group of 60 clinics lets patients find a free slot, book it and get a text reminder. Slots open at 8 am, and the phone lines used to melt. Two people must never get the same slot, and reminders must go out even when the text-message company has a bad hour.

The daily scenario changes the event schedule and pressure. Read the base problem for its requirements and concepts, then open this date’s challenge to see the daily variant.
